templates.text: Before a warm room, I stand beneath the open sky. Find the tavern door from outside.
Search the threshold outside the east outskirts tavern.
Two places welcome the line; choose the river mark above its twin.
Search beside the upper river fishing spot.
Follow the pair of fishing marks downward; the lower one holds this instruction.
Search beside the lower river fishing spot.
Stone lies beyond me, but open sky stays overhead. Find the cave mouth from the outskirts.
Search outside the Golem cave entrance in the outskirts.
From the warm room I lead back to the open air. Stand at the tavern exit.
Search inside the tavern beside its exit.
Within the tavern I turn a catch into a meal. Find the stove.
Search beside the cooking stove inside the tavern.
From stone halls I point east toward the open outskirts. Find the kingdom exit.
Search beside the east exit inside Golem Kingdom.
Reverse these letters: EVOTS. Find the decoded place inside the tavern.
Shift each letter back one: MPXFS SJWFS. Find the decoded fishing mark.
With Fishing level 20 or higher, land a Raw Reedkip at the upper river fishing spot after this directive becomes active.
With Fishing level 20 or higher, land a Raw Reedkip at the lower river fishing spot after this directive becomes active.
With Cooking level 20 or higher, successfully cook a Raw Reedkip at the tavern stove after this directive becomes active. Burnt fish do not count.
With Fishing level 40 or higher, land a Raw Reedkip at the upper river fishing spot after this directive becomes active.
With Fishing level 40 or higher, land a Raw Reedkip at the lower river fishing spot after this directive becomes active.
With Cooking level 40 or higher, successfully cook a Raw Reedkip at the tavern stove after this directive becomes active. Burnt fish do not count.
With Fishing level 65 or higher, land a Raw Reedkip at the upper river fishing spot after this directive becomes active.
With Fishing level 65 or higher, land a Raw Reedkip at the lower river fishing spot after this directive becomes active.
With Cooking level 65 or higher, successfully cook a Raw Reedkip at the tavern stove after this directive becomes active. Burnt fish do not count.
